title: Butterskull Ranch

location.name: Butterskull Ranch
location.description: A homestead and dairy ranch on the plains, its farmhouse smashed and its owners the Anchorite family missing. A band of orcs, pushed out of the hills by Cryovain, has occupied the ranch and is butchering the livestock.

read_aloud: Smoke rises from Butterskull Ranch — not from a chimney, but from a smashed farmhouse. Orcs lounge in the yard amid slaughtered cattle, and a great brute of one bellows orders. From the root cellar comes a muffled thumping: someone is trapped down there, alive.

enemies.position: spread across the yard and farmhouse
enemies.special: Aggressive; use the buildings for cover.

enemies.position: by the barn — the orcs' muscle
enemies.special: Boss of the band. If it falls, surviving orcs may rout (DC 12 WIS).

encounters.tactics: Orcs charge (Aggressive); the ogre smashes through cover to reach the party. Rescuing the Anchorites (locked in the root cellar) is a secondary objective — orcs may threaten them if losing. Kicking over the smoldering farmhouse timbers or spooking the remaining cattle are usable tricks.
encounters.description: Orc raiders occupying the ranch, with the Anchorite family held in the cellar.

npcs.name: The Anchorite Family
dialog_hooks: Farmers locked in the root cellar; freed, they reward the party and rebuild
Grateful — offer the party free lodging and dairy goods, and word travels (reputation)

loot.location: the Anchorites' cellar stores, offered in thanks

skill_checks.success: Force the barred cellar door quickly to free the Anchorites mid-fight.
skill_checks.failure: The door holds; the family stays trapped until the fight ends.

dm_notes: SCALING (6 PCs, +50%): 6 orcs + 1 ogre (from ~4 orcs). Straightforward brawl with a rescue objective. 3+ interactables: smoldering farmhouse timbers (fire hazard/cover collapse), panicked cattle (stampede lane — Animal Handling to direct), the cellar door (rescue).
